title: A bouncing ball
hints: Start with a copy: const next = { ...ball, x: ball.x + ball.vx * dt, y: ball.y + ball.vy * dt };
Left wall: if (next.x - next.r < 0) { next.x = next.r; next.vx = Math.abs(next.vx); }
Right wall: next.x = width - next.r and next.vx = -Math.abs(next.vx). Then the same two checks for y.
